IT Officer Job at Pelb Consulting Limited




        
    

        
        Pelb Consulting Limited is a premier provider of recruitment and staffing solutions, dedicated to helping organizations identify and attract the right talent to drive their success. With a deep understanding of the ever-evolving workforce landscape, we offer comprehensive talent management and human resource advisory services tailored to meet the unique needs of businesses across various sectors. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Title: IT Officer
Job Location: Jakande/Chevron, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
Technical Support:
     

            
    




	Provide technical support to end-users for hardware, software, and network issues.
	Respond to and resolve IT service requests and incidents in a timely manner.
	Assist with the setup, configuration, and maintenance of computers, servers, and network devices.


Network Management:


	Monitor and maintain network infrastructure, including switches, routers, firewalls, and wireless access points.
	Ensure network security and performance through regular monitoring and updates.


System Administration:


	Manage user accounts, permissions, and access controls.
	Perform routine maintenance and updates on servers, workstations, and other IT equipment.
	Ensure regular data backups and perform disaster recovery operations when necessary.


Software Management:


	Install, configure, and update software applications.
	Maintain software licensing and compliance.
	Assist in the evaluation and deployment of new software solutions.


Documentation and Reporting:


	Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation of IT infrastructure, configurations, and procedures.
	Prepare and present regular reports on IT performance and incidents.
	Document and report on IT issues and resolutions.


Requirements and Qualification


	Candidates should possess a Bachelor's Degree in releveant field.
	Minimum of 3 years relevant technical experience.
	Must know how to install, configure, maintain and troubleshoot equipment, systems and programs used by the School
	Ability to respond rapidly to operating and security problems.
	Must be able to prioritize activities and delegate tasks.
	Must be able to read, interpret and apply complex technical information.
	Ability to develop and maintain positive working relationships with and instruct/tutor students and staff, plan and conduct group demonstrations, workshops, and training.


Salary
Very competitive

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV in word template to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note


	Only qualified candidates with good proximities will be shortlisted
	The job location is at Lekki-Ajah axis and no accommodation will be provided

title: Job Openings at Wahala No Dey Finish
content:
Wahala No Dey Finish - Come Chop is a food content brand that focuses on creating engaging video content and high-quality visuals. They are active on platforms like YouTube and Facebook, showcasing food-related challenges and culinary showdowns, aiming to build an active and positive online community around their unique brand identity in the food content industry.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Content Creator and Videographer

Job Location: Lagos

Responsibilities
Content Strategy and Planning:
     

            
    




	Collaborate with the team to develop and implement a comprehensive content strategy aligned with the brand's vision, tone, and values.


Video Production and Editing:


	Operate video and photography equipment to capture high-quality footage and images.
	Edit raw video footage into compelling narratives, incorporating graphics, music, and sound effects to enhance viewer experience.


Qualifications and Skills


	Proven experience as a Content Creator, Video Producer, or similar role, with a strong portfolio showcasing video production and editing skills.
	Demonstrable expertise in shooting and editing video content, with proficiency in video editing software (e.g., CapCut Pro,Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve).
	Strong understanding of visual storytelling principles and an eye for aesthetics.
	Familiarity with various social media platforms and their content requirements (especially YouTube and Instagram).


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Portfolio to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

2.) Social Media Manager

Job Location: Lagos

Job Description
Platform Management and Community Engagement:


	Actively foster an engaged and positive online community, encouraging discussions and user-generated content.
	Monitor social media channels for trends, feedback, and opportunities for engagement.
	Content Strategy and Calendar Planning
	Performance Analysis and Reporting.


Qualifications and Skills


	Experience as a Social Media Manager or similar role, with a strong track record of managing and growing social media platforms.
	Passion for food content and a desire to contribute to a growing brand.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and portfolio to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
